description: This file defines a set of SCSS mixins related to rendering carets (arrow icons) pointing in various directions, used for styling UI elements like dropdowns or indicators.

methods.name: caret
methods.description: Main mixin to generate a caret arrow with configurable direction, width, spacing, and vertical alignment.

methods.name: caret-down
methods.description: Mixin to generate a downward pointing caret.

methods.name: caret-up
methods.description: Mixin to generate an upward pointing caret.

methods.name: caret-end
methods.description: Mixin to generate a caret at the end position.

methods.name: caret-start
methods.description: Mixin to generate a caret at the start position.
